description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three metrics: the sparsity ratio before the gate (blue dashed line, average 0.003), the sparsity ratio after the gate (orange dotted line, average 0.126), and the sparsity ratio after the average gate (green dashed line, average 0.080). The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, and is labeled “Layer”. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2, and is labeled “Sparsity Ratio”. The blue dashed line starts near 0.002 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat near 0.001 throughout the plot. The orange dotted line starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.05 at layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly before ending near 0.02 at layer 20. The green dashed line starts at approximately 0.78 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.02 at layer 10, and then remains nearly flat near 0.01 through layer 20.
